items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I think that was Delachez and Saratoa, where they had a dance.

ctx.x: ...trio out at the country club too. Oh yeah. When Tom and me had a big band, he had a... He had a regular spot. They had the Royal Palm Garden. I think that was Delachez and Saratoa, where they had a dance. Yeah.

We have only about a minute left on. I was going to ask if you ever made any other records besides the ones that they haven't come out, but someday they will. The ones you made with the... The only record I ever... ...Charlie Love and Giles. Charlie Love and Giles.
